exec: pm.test("grounded answer with citations", () => { pm.expect(body.data.grounded).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.citations).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.citations[0].title).to.eql("B+ trees on Disks"); });
